title: Animating Shape/Mesh properties do not reliably RESET on determistic AnimtionPlayers
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in 4.7, 4.8 dev6

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev6 - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (2880x1920 @ 119.97 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840U w/ Radeon  780M Graphics (16 threads) - 30.64 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

For player animations in a fighting game I am primarily animating the collision shapes of Area3D nodes.
This mainly affects the properties `position`, `disabled` and `radius` / `size` of the shape.

I enabled the `deterministic` property of the AnimatonPlayer to make sure that all tracks use the RESET animation as a default value.
This works mostly well but not for any of the shape properties! 

### Steps to reproduce

Check out the MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_collisions_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32685016/MRP_collisions_bug.zip)

The above project already set up the Collision Shapes and other nodes. They are all animated to see what part of the animation works and what not. The AnimationPlayer is also set to deterministic.

(Make sure to launch the game with 'Visible Collision Shapes' enabled.

Press either left arrow key to animate the sphere or right arrow key to animate the box.
You will see that the animated shapes are raised in their position, reshaped and disabled. The other shape will be put back to the RESET values.

The issue is that the mesh and shape properties like `radius` and `size` are not set to the RESET value but instead the initial value of the previously active animation!
But if you start the same animation twice in succession, the `size` and `radius` will properly use the RESET values. 

The expected result should be that pressing left or right multiple times in succession should always show the same animation result.
